root_cause: The modal's Escape key handler closes the dialog even when the Escape key is pressed inside an open dropdown menu. The event bubbles from the dropdown menu item up to the modal element, triggering the modal's keydown listener before the dropdown's delegated handler can close only the menu.
repair_strategy: Modify the modal's Escape key handler to ignore Escape events that originate from within an open dropdown menu (element with class 'dropdown-menu.show'). This allows the dropdown's own Escape handling to close the menu while keeping the modal open. When focus is on the dropdown toggle button (outside the menu), the modal will still close as required.
expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape while focus is on the access toggle button closes the share dialog. Pressing Escape while focus is inside the open dropdown menu closes only the dropdown menu, leaving the dialog open.
functional_risks: If other components use the same dropdown menu markup inside modals, they will also be prevented from closing on Escape.
The selector '.dropdown-menu.show' relies on Bootstrap's internal class names; if the dropdown implementation changes, this may need updating.
verification_requirements: Verify Escape closes the modal when focus is on the access toggle button.
Verify Escape closes only the dropdown menu when focus is on a dropdown menu item.
Verify that after closing the dropdown menu with Escape, focus returns to the access toggle button.
Verify that the modal can still be closed by Escape when focus is elsewhere in the modal (e.g., on the Cancel button).
Verify that the regression guard 'Escape inside the open access menu closes only the menu' passes.
